Eilidh —

We spotted two blockers in under a minute:
- heatherandpine.co.uk shows a 502 (Bad Gateway). Today: 301 it to a working page so every click survives.
- heatherandpine.com is a “new products coming soon” splash with store hours, but no clear way to buy.

Three fixes to ship today (fastest first)
1) Single‑offer hero
Big photo • Title: Custom‑engraved [best‑seller]
Price • Fields (Name/Initials, Style) • Button: Personalise & Buy
Below: 3 bullets (material, sizing, care) + one trust cue (customer photo/line)
2) Redirect .co.uk → that offer page until the UK site is healthy.
3) Add a 3‑step Gift Finder (Who for? Budget? Style?) that returns 1–3 buyable items. This pattern lifted conversion for Tallow & Thyme (4.8% vs 1.9%).

What to watch this week
- Hero button click‑through (aim for double‑digit % of homepage visitors)
- Add‑to‑cart rate on the offer page
- Orders or in‑store reservations started (count this, not just visits)

Reply if you want these sketched on your real content so you can paste them straight in.
